title: [V1] V1 engine implements parallel sampling (AsyncLLM and LLMEngine)
reported_gain: N/A (feature PR adding n>1 support; no speedup benchmark published)
note: Feature PR: adds parallel sampling (n>1) to the V1 AsyncLLM and LLMEngine by branching a parent request into n child n=1 requests and aggregating their outputs (new vllm/v1/engine/parallel_sampling.py plus async_llm/llm_engine wrappers). It enables a capability, not an optimization, and the body/comments publish no before/after timings. The only ratio in the thread is a '3x throughput regression' attributed to the OLD V0 PR #9302, which this PR is meant to avoid (V1 relies on default prefix caching to dedup the shared prompt); that is a qualitative claim about a different PR, not a measured speedup here. No speedup experiment applies, so experiments is empty.
environment: reported-only: no author speedup numbers (feature PR); no measured arm applicable
